reviewItem.question: Does "Added ingress-shim option `--extra-certificate-annotations`, which sets a list of annotation keys to be copied from Ingress-like to resulting Certificate object" mean a change to cli-flag:cert-manager|name=--extra-certificate-annotations|component=ingress-shim (added)?

proposed.statement: The ingress-shim component adds a new command-line flag --extra-certificate-annotations that allows specifying annotation keys to be copied from Ingress-like resources to resulting Certificate objects.
